body: Owner asked for a full review (board, CLI, core, MCP) and for the certain findings to be fixed. Scope of this task: the bugs that were verified in the code. Merges, renames and removals of pages, commands and tools are listed for the owner and not done here.

completion.summary: Review of board, CLI, core and MCP by three read-only audits. Fixed what was verified: recursive warn in withExport (stack overflow on a refused export), completing an already-done task replaced its completion, the handoff tag could be set by hand on a note, readSnapshot threw a TypeError on an object id (found by the fuzz test), clearer `comment add` error, inbox in the help's Start group, docs name `sync export`/`sync import`, README version example, stale idea removed. Each bug has a test. Gate green: core 379, cli 281 (+3 skipped), sync 58, store 92, mcp 32, ui 40. Consolidation of pages, commands and tools is listed for the owner, not done.

title: Whole-project review: fix the certain bugs and stale docs it found
